observations.footer-free-proof: Only if prev-free is set may predecessor footer be read; validate footer extent and matching predecessor header before unlink. Clear/update next prev-free on allocate/free/split/merge, including sentinel. Freely scanning bytes backward is unsound.

unaligned-base.byte_offsets: Relative XOR remains correct at physical base3; payload alignment8 is rejected unless an admitted prefix aligns the base and reduces usable capacity. A64-aligned start is unnecessary for an8-aligned byte policy.
unaligned-base.cross-region: Even adjacent physical addresses have distinct owner identities. Region-end blocks never merge across owners.

retained-ast-slice.rule: AST owner lasts through8; alternatively copy the needed slice into response storage before5.

messages.unbounded_admission: without an explicit bound on retained completions, fixed concurrency of processing does not bound outstanding response storage

independent-release.cycle_rule: Owner-region graph must be acyclic; borrowed back edges end before destruction. General cycles require separately implemented tracing/cycle collection or explicit graph teardown.

slabs.compaction: No relocation while raw borrows are live. Owner-stable index/generation handles need an updated location table; lookup and quiescence costs remain.

class_lifetime.assumption: Separate class/lifetime owners release wholly empty slabs; fixed embedded C arrays themselves remain allocated until their containing owner ends.

pool-representations.embedded_link: Only freed storage; requires enough space/alignment and type-valid accesses. A1-byte payload cannot contain a pointer. Store byte-encoded indices or use a typed union/external links.

owner-lifetimes.raw_pointer: No revocation: handle check does not validate saved raw view. End borrows before rollback/reset/resize.
owner-lifetimes.control_move: A live stable control address is part of every handle precondition; moving or ending it invalidates all handles. Never compare an indeterminate pointer after owner destruction.
owner-lifetimes.serial_retirement: UINT32_MAX rejects creation; release/reset remain permitted; reinitialization requires quiescence and invalidation of every old handle, not just zeroing counters.

callbacks.escape: Callbacks cannot reenter/mutate allocator or retain temporary source/destination pointers. If asynchronous retention is required, transfer an explicitly owned object and delay rollback until acknowledgment.
callbacks.partial_cleanup: Initializer/copy callback rolls back its own acquired subresources before failure; allocator discards staged byte/metadata state. Cleanup errors accumulate while all remaining cleanups run.
callbacks.longjmp: Nonlocal exit through callbacks/allocator is unsupported. A higher recovery owner must perform explicit cleanup after a jump; jumping does not rewind a separate arena.
callbacks.self_pointers: Byte migration excludes self/interior pointers requiring repair. Use an explicit relocation callback with offsets or stable descriptors; never infer relocatability from trivially copyable bytes.

stable-descriptor.identity: stable client index, generation and live owner
stable-descriptor.move: replace descriptor underlying ALHandle after successful resize; retain old on failure
stable-descriptor.cost: O(1) descriptor lookup plus underlying bounded linear search; mutation requires ending old raw borrows
stable-descriptor.limits: No automatic concurrent-reader quiescence or pointer rewriting.

latency-policy.admission: Fixed request queue capacity8, reject ninth; one owner processes at most15 buddy node visits/request.
latency-policy.limits: Queue wait still needs a bounded service/scheduling contract. pthread mutex fairness and measured samples do not supply hard deadlines.

standards.N3096: 7.24.3.7 nonnull realloc with size zero undefined; null pointer follows malloc.
standards.C17: Exact published wording not newly inspected. Do not label either draft as C17; local API rejects every zero-size resize.
